svg.text: prev_hash points at the previous line; the first line seeds the chain with 64 zeros

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text:
hash = sha256( prev_hash + "
" + seq + "
" + kind + "
" + canonical(payload) )

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: canonical sorts keys, drops undefined, formats numbers with toPrecision(17)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ts stays outside the payload and outside the hash, so re-sealing keeps event identity

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: verify recomputes the whole chain; seal rewrites it after an intentional edit
